overview: Collision detection; minimum frame size = 2 x Tp x bandwidth.
coreConcept: Sender ko collision tabhi pata chale jab wo abhi transmit kar raha ho: Tt >= 2 Tp.
hinglishExplanation: Min frame size (bits) = 2 x (distance / speed) x bandwidth. Bandwidth badhne par frame size badhta hai ya length ghatti hai.
formalDefinition: Sender ko collision tabhi pata chale jab wo abhi transmit kar raha ho: Tt >= 2 Tp.
importantProperties: Min frame = 2 x Tp x B.
Ethernet CSMA/CD use karta hai; wireless CSMA/CA.
